name: Exp_CorrectedAverage
summary: This EA implements a breakout trading system based on the CorrectedAverage custom moving average indicator. It enters long when price breaks above the moving average by a specified level, and enters short when price breaks below. Positions are managed with fixed stop loss and take profit levels, with optional permissions for buy/sell entry and exit.
summary_zh: 该EA基于CorrectedAverage修正均线指标实现突破交易系统。当价格突破均线上方指定点位时做多，跌破均线下方指定点位时做空。使用固定止损和止盈管理仓位，并可独立控制买卖方向的入场和出场权限。
strategy_analysis: 该EA采用基于CorrectedAverage修正均线的突破策略，核心概念是当价格偏离均线达到指定突破水平(Level点)时确认趋势启动并入场。入场条件为：当前K线收盘价高于均线值加突破水平时触发做多信号，前一根K线收盘价低于均线值加突破水平以确保是突破而非持续偏离；做空条件对称。出场条件包括固定止损(StopLoss)和止盈(TakeProfit)点位，以及反向信号触发平仓——即做多信号出现时若允许则平空仓，做空信号出现时若允许则平多仓。仓位管理通过MM参数控制，负值代表固定手数，正值代表按存款比例计算仓位。资金管理依赖TradeAlgorithms.mqh库函数执行，止损止盈以点数设定。策略仅在新K线形成时检测信号(SignalBar=0除外)，避免重复交易，同时使用Recount机制确保数据获取失败时重新计算。
strategy_analysis_en: This EA implements a breakout strategy based on the CorrectedAverage custom moving average indicator. The core concept is to confirm a trend initiation when price deviates from the moving average by a specified breakthrough level (Level points) and enter accordingly. Entry conditions: a buy signal triggers when the current bar's close exceeds the indicator value plus the breakthrough level, with the previous bar's close at or below that threshold to confirm a fresh breakout rather than a continued deviation; sell conditions are symmetrical. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss and take profit levels in points, plus counter-signal exits — a buy signal closes short positions if permitted, and a sell signal closes long positions if permitted. Position sizing is controlled by the MM parameter: negative values represent fixed lot sizes, while positive values represent a share of the deposit. Money management relies on the TradeAlgorithms.mqh library functions for execution. The strategy only checks for signals on new bar formation (unless SignalBar=0), preventing duplicate trades, and uses a Recount mechanism to retry data fetching on failure.

pros: 策略逻辑清晰，基于均线突破的原理简单有效，易于理解和优化
提供独立的买卖方向入场和出场权限控制，灵活性高，可适应不同市场观点
使用新K线检测机制避免同一根K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
止损止盈参数完整，配合反向信号平仓提供多重出场保护
Recount机制确保数据获取失败时不会丢失信号，增强了数据可靠性
pros_en: Clear strategy logic based on moving average breakout — simple, effective, easy to understand and optimize
Independent buy/sell entry and exit permission controls provide high flexibility to adapt to different market views
New bar detection mechanism prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading risk
Complete stop loss and take profit parameters combined with counter-signal exits provide multiple exit protections
Recount mechanism ensures signals are not lost on data fetch failures, enhancing data reliability
cons: 缺乏止损止盈的动态调整机制，固定点数止损可能在波动性变化时不够灵活
没有过滤交易时段或市场波动性的机制，可能在低流动性或高波动时段产生不利交易
未进行点差过滤，在点差较大的品种上可能导致突破信号被点差吞噬
MM参数的正负值含义不直观，容易造成用户误配置
依赖外部自定义指标CorrectedAverage和TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，缺乏独立性，部署时需确保这些依赖可用
cons_en: Lacks dynamic stop loss/take profit adjustment — fixed-point stops may be inflexible when volatility changes
No trading session or market volatility filter, potentially generating unfavorable trades during low liquidity or high volatility periods
No spread filter, so on high-spread instruments the breakout signal may be consumed by the spread
The MM parameter's dual meaning (negative=lot, positive=share) is unintuitive and prone to user misconfiguration
Depends on the external custom CorrectedAverage indicator and TradeAlgorithms.mqh library, reducing independence and requiring these dependencies at deployment
improvements: 增加ATR或波动性自适应的止损止盈机制，替代固定点数，使风险管理随市场波动动态调整
添加点差过滤和交易时段过滤，避免在高点差或低流动性时段入场
增加移动止损(Trailing Stop)功能，在趋势延续时锁定浮动利润
improvements_en: Add ATR-based or volatility-adaptive stop loss/take profit instead of fixed points, enabling dynamic risk management that adjusts to market volatility
Add spread filter and trading session filter to avoid entries during high spread or low liquidity periods
Add a trailing stop feature to lock in floating profits when the trend continues

risk_points: 固定止损止盈不适应市场波动性变化，可能在剧烈行情中止损过小或止盈过大
缺少点差过滤，高点差环境下突破信号可能无效
MM参数负值为固定手数的逻辑容易误操作，若误设正值可能导致过大仓位
risk_points_en: Fixed stop loss/take profit does not adapt to market volatility changes — stops may be too tight or targets too wide during volatile moves
No spread filter means breakout signals may be invalid in high-spread environments
The MM parameter's negative=lot logic is prone to misoperation — accidentally setting a positive value could result in oversized positions
